description: Provides persistent vector memory capabilities including rule/fact storage with deduplication, semantic retrieval, two-pass expunging, and ledger summarization.
author: Charon Librarian

data_archivist_store.description: Stores an operational rule or fact into ChromaDB with deduplication validation.

fact.description: The exact rule, memory candidate, or text fact to commit.

category.description: Classification category for the stored record.

data_archivist_search.description: Retrieves semantic or exact rule matches from the vector memory ledger.

query.description: The search query or prompt to match against stored ledger rules.

n_results.description: Maximum number of matched records to retrieve.

data_archivist_expunge.description: Locates and deletes rules using literal substring match or semantic similarity fallback.

target_concept.description: Substring or semantic target concept to locate and remove.

data_archivist_summarize.description: Generates a high-level categorized count and status report of active ledger records.
